nativePipelines.license: SelfDM research-only; SuperGlue noncommercial/internal restrictions; public redistribution requires review
nativePipelines.numerical: Original Float32 model/CV formulas, original-grid CRF and receptive-field windows. CPU/GPU rounding is measured rather than claimed bit-exact universally: the windowed 831x641 GPU case has zero mask differences and continuous maximum0.0011100769; the CPU case differs at1 threshold-boundary pixel. Some continuous maxima exceed the provisional0.001 target; the qualification receipts preserve those failed-parity statuses. Near-equal SuperPoint TopK scores can reorder. See the current windowed integration qualification receipts.
nativePipelines.inputColorOrder: BGR initial map/CRF; RGB DeepMask; upstream RGB passed to BGR2GRAY/SEEDS

data.arrayLayout: segmented; readPlane/readMask windows or streamed NPZ export

result.semantics: Native sigmoid or target/source/background class probabilities, independent rectangle inference and maximum/OR composition. No D2PRL residual roles or component filter.

model.numericalParity: Complete SelfDM, DeepMask, Proposal SuperGlue, SEEDS and ConvCRF chain. Initial network at512; refinement and output at the original rectangle dimensions using DeepMask/SuperPoint/CRF halo windows and global coordinates, with native global SuperPoint NMS/TopK/descriptor sampling. SuperPoint is separately qualified through2000×1500. Measured Float32 differences remain: one threshold-crossing pixel on the declared831×641 CPU case; continuous errors and CPU/WebGPU qualifications are recorded separately. This is not universal bit-exact parity.
model.license: Local research only. SelfDM and SuperGlue redistribution/use terms require separate review before public distribution.
